why_it_matters.text: A sulfonamide antibiotic usually paired with trimethoprim as co-trimoxazole, sold as Bactrim and Septra. It stops bacteria from making folate.

approval.basis: Marketed today (prescription) under NDA 017377 in the Drugs@FDA data files.
